title: A prefix of a nonhalting run does not halt
statement: Let $r$ map bit strings to optional values, and suppose that once $r$ returns a value on a string, it returns the same value on every extension of that string. If $r$ returns no value on a bit string $w$, then it returns no value on every prefix of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is prefix-stable: any returned value persists on every extension
